messages:
sara_fin: Alert: Kestrel Labs INV-2029-078 for $42,300 still unpaid after ACH R03 on 2024-03-18. AP claims missing PO. We've exhausted soft dunning. Looking for an alternative to immediate collections — sales proposes escrow/partial payment while procurement validates PO. Thoughts?

billing-bot: Soft dunning delivered to billing@kestrel.com at 2255559999. Next ACH retry scheduled at +48h.

eli_sales: Sales checked in: procurement asked for a PO before wiring. CFO offered to move 50% to an escrow account immediately if we sign an addendum confirming funds release once PO confirmed. They want product access to remain active.

michelle_csr: We can issue a one-time pay link for partial amount. Suggest: create two links (first 50% now, remainder on PO confirmation). Also include wire instructions for expedited payment.

tom_ops: I can generate split pay links and flag invoice as 'pending-escrow' in ledger. Command snippet I used before:
```
redwood billing link create --invoice INV-2029-078 --amt 21150 --meta escrowsplit=1 --ttl 5d
```

sara_fin: I prefer cash in hand rather than escrow unless legal approves escrow terms. If they wire 50% to escrow, we need a clear trigger to release funds. Maria/legal - can you draft addendum language?

maria_legal: We can do an addendum. Key items: 1) confirmation that escrowed funds cover the undisputed portion, 2) release conditions tied to PO issuance or written confirmation from procurement, 3) explicit waiver that undisputed amounts remain payable, 4) payment schedule, 5) late fee for remainder. I'll prepare a tight one-paragraph addendum and send for quick sign. Note: escrow introduces extra administrative overhead; prefer direct split payment to our account if possible.

dawn_collections: Collections POV: escrow helps reduce recovery risk but delays timeline. If we accept split payment, document that remaining balance is due within X days and that service may be suspended if not paid. Also set a hard external collections trigger (e.g., 30 days from original invoice) so we don't lose leverage.

eli_sales: Sales can draft the addendum template for speed. Kestrel wants minimal legal language. If legal approves the draft I can route to their CFO today.

michelle_csr: I'll prepare two pay links now (50% + balance placeholder) and attach ledger snapshot to the addendum. Also include card and wire options.

billing-bot: Payment link (50%): https://pay.redwood.example/lnk/pay50kestrel (expires in 5 days). Placeholder balance link: https://pay.redwood.example/lnk/paybalkestrel (expires in 30 days).

sara_fin: OK — action items: 1) Maria to post addendum draft here, 2) Michelle to attach ledger & invoice pdf to the addendum email, 3) Tom to mark invoice pending-escrow if first payment clears, 4) Dawn to note external-collections trigger 30 days from invoice date. We will not suspend service unless remainder unpaid after agreed window.

maria_legal: Draft posted at 2255560400 below. Short addendum text: "Customer will remit 50% of INV-2029-078 to Redwood within 5 business days to the designated account. Remaining balance due within 20 calendar days of issuance of customer PO. Redwood will release escrowed funds upon receipt of written confirmation from customer procurement that PO # is issued referencing INV-2029-078. Undisputed charges remain payable; disputes must be provided in writing. Failure to pay remaining balance by due date will incur 10% late fee and may result in service suspension and external collections per SOW 4.2."

eli_sales: Sending to their CFO now. Copying procurement contact procurement@kestrel.com. Will report back.

michelle_csr: Addendum email sent at 2255560600 with invoice PDF, ledger extract, and first-pay link. Subject: "Addendum & Payment Links for INV-2029-078 (PO pending)".

tom_ops: Noted. I'll set invoice status to pending-escrow upon payment confirmation and queue the automatic reminders for the balance.

dawn_collections: Logged internal note: ESCALATE-INV-2029-078. External collections trigger set for 30 days after invoice (2024-04-17). If balance unpaid by then we escalate. Will hold off while addendum flow completes.

sara_fin: Great. Keep this thread updated with payment confirmations and any PO docs. If they counter with alternative timeline, flag it here before signing. :white_check_mark:
